h1: Custom Fleece Blankets for Your Brand
metaDescription: Order custom fleece blankets for your next promotion or event. Soft, warm, and perfect for branding. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Fleece blankets offer a cozy, lightweight warmth that makes them a favorite for giveaways, corporate gifts, and outdoor events. Unlike heavier woven throws, fleece is soft to the touch, easy to fold, and takes screen printing or embroidery beautifully. Whether you choose a classic plaid fleece or a roll-up blanket for trade shows, these blankets keep your logo visible and your recipients comfortable. Perfect for marketing directors planning winter campaigns or HR directors looking for a thoughtful employee gift.
heroAltText: Custom fleece blankets with embroidered logo, soft fleece material, folded and displayed
